name: finish-picker-audit
description: Cohesion + responsiveness audit of the FinishPicker surface (floor/wall/ceiling swatch grids, designer picks, composer, accent walls, copy/layout tools). Desktop 1600x1000 + mobile 390x844, light + dark, Simple + Pro.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: expand-floor-composer
steps.eval: (() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('.compose-summary')].find(el => el.textContent?.includes('Compose your own')); const d = s?.closest('details'); if (d) d.open = true; s?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }) })()

steps.name: expand-mobile-composer
steps.eval: (() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('.compose-summary')].find(el => el.textContent?.includes('Compose your own')); const d = s?.closest('details'); if (d) d.open = true; s?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }) })()

steps.name: collapse-mobile-composer
steps.eval: (() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('.compose-summary')].find(el => el.textContent?.includes('Compose your own')); const d = s?.closest('details'); if (d) d.open = false })()

steps.name: scroll-mobile-bottom
steps.eval: const p = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector .panel-body'); if (p) p.scrollTop = p.scrollHeight
